import copy,json
from pathlib import Path
from work import evaluate
requests=json.loads(Path('requests.json').read_text())
policy=json.loads(Path('policy.json').read_text())
actual=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
report=json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())
assert actual==report,(actual,report)
cases=[({'declared':['z','a','z'],'saved':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'1','meta':{'b':2,'a':1}},'a':{'kind':'missing'}},'current':{'z':{'meta':{'a':1,'b':2},'hash':'1','kind':'file'}},'noise':{'changed':True}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),({'declared':['z','a','z'],'saved':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}},'irrelevant':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},{'ignored':['z']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'h','timestamp':1}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'h','timestamp':2}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']})]
for i,(req,pol,want) in enumerate(cases):
 rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)
 got=evaluate(req,pol)
 assert got==want,(i,got,want)
 assert req==rb and pol==pb
print(json.dumps({'fixture_results':actual,'report_matches':True,'boundary_cases':len(cases),'status':'pass'},sort_keys=True))
